scoring.code: Execute all original and added tests in an isolated CPU sandbox; all must pass. Do not run model-generated code in the controller.
scoring.math: Allow reasoning; parse the explicit FINAL_ANSWER numeric line and compare numerically. Report format errors separately.
scoring.instruction_following: Unmodified official prompt-level strict scorer; raw response, all declared constraints must pass. No universal answer wrapper.
scoring.truncation: finish_reason=length => TRUNCATED, distinct from wrong answer. Keep it in the denominator, never silently discard.

scope_limits: This is a small frozen regression subset, not an official benchmark score or proof over all inputs.
IFEval checks the declared constraints, not factual accuracy or prose quality.
Primarily original English prompts. Chinese language quality and long-context correctness are not established by this subset.
Native-image validation is separate from the historical subset selection; no native pass is implied by selecting these cases.
selection_bias: Retain 71 of the 72 historical regression cases and the 28 original additions. Replace C26 (HumanEval/10) with HumanEval/19 following output-budget truncation on the native baseline. Selection is baseline-informed; this is a curated regression suite, not an unbiased model capability benchmark.
